title: WP5 optomotor yaw: causal test of one full-graph sensory-brain-motor loop
declared_at: 2026-09-19, before any confirmatory run; the script records this file's sha256 in every output

io_map.encoder_cells: T4a+T5a (front-to-back) and T4b+T5b (back-to-front) per eye, eye = annotated somaSide; 835 T4 + 826 T5 per population (lowest source IDs)
io_map.decoder_cells: DNa02_L (body 523769, node 131957) and DNa02_R (body 10360, node 332), by instance and somaSide
io_map.no_other_inputs: No tonic, looming, olfactory or DN drive of any kind. The cosim_server ENGINEERED_ASSISTANCE paths are not used.

hypothesis: If the fixed-weight full graph carries a syndirectional optomotor pathway from eye-specific T4/T5 to DNa02, rotation to the left (s=+1) raises DNa02_L relative to DNa02_R and the decoded yaw follows the stimulus (turning index > 0).
sign_convention: s=+1: pattern rotates counter-clockwise seen from above (leftward); left eye sees front-to-back, right eye back-to-front. Yaw + = counter-clockwise (leftward) turn = arena heading increase. Syndirectional following = sign(yaw) == s.

stimulus.i_max_rationale: equal to the WP4 validation stimulus amplitude; not tuned
stimulus.blocks_format: [direction s, contrast]; counterbalanced order, fixed for every condition and seed
stimulus.mode: open loop (tethered): slip = s * angular_velocity during a block, 0 in gray

decoder.rule: yaw = gain * (filtered rate DNa02_L - filtered rate DNa02_R); unclipped, no rectification, no fallback

amendment_after_pilot.pilot: outputs/wp5/pilot-20260919/pilot.json: seed 999, 3.5 s simulated in 29.4 s wall (0.119 sim s per wall s); driven encoder populations fired 13-18 Hz per cell, undriven 0 Hz; projected confirmatory runtime 69.9 min > 60 min
amendment_after_pilot.change: Seeds cut from [0..9] to [0..5] exactly as the pilot clause prescribes. No other parameter changed. The pilot's DN outputs were not inspected (the script drops them before printing or saving).

seed_role: Seed sets the encoder's per-cell phases and per-step noise (numpy default_rng(seed)). The LIF graph itself is deterministic given its input.

conditions.dna02_silenced: real graph, sensory delivered, DNa02_L and DNa02_R clamped with drive -200 every step
conditions.sham_no_input: real graph, encoder runs with identical RNG stream but its output is not delivered
conditions.shuffled_graph: CONTROL GRAPH, labelled: the real graph's post (target) array permuted once with numpy default_rng(777); preserves every neuron's out-degree, in-degree and per-source weights; destroys wiring specificity. Run in registry test mode because it is not the released graph.
conditions.modular_baseline: vision.CompoundEyeVision open loop, dt 0.02 s, external_yaw_rad_s = s*angular_velocity, contrast c, fly at rest; yaw = get_optomotor_yaw_bias() (the modular arena adds this directly to dheading, rad/s)

outcomes.primary: Turning index TI (rad/s) per seed = mean over the 8 stimulus blocks of s_b * mean decoded yaw within block b.
neural_response: A_DNa02 (Hz) = mean over blocks of s_b * (spike rate DNa02_L - spike rate DNa02_R)
dV_DNa02 (mV) = mean over blocks of s_b * (end-of-step v DNa02_L - v DNa02_R)
eye asymmetry of monitored populations (HS, H2, VS, LLPC1, PFL3, DNa01, DNa03) as s_b-aligned L-R spike rate, and spike rates for s=+1 vs s=-1 separately
encoder population spike rates (sanity: driven cells fire)
outcomes.motor_dependence: (i) intact vs dna02_silenced paired difference in TI; (ii) across blocks of the intact condition, Pearson r between s_b-aligned eye asymmetry of HS and A_DNa02 per block, and between A_DNa02 and s_b*yaw
outcomes.secondary: TI separately at contrast 1.0 and 0.5; DNa01 asymmetry (not decoded)

analysis.summary: mean over seeds, SD, 95% percentile bootstrap CI (10000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20260919))
analysis.paired: intact - {dna02_silenced, sham_no_input, shuffled_graph} per seed, bootstrap CI, Cohen dz when SD > 0

decision_rule.POSITIVE: intact TI CI entirely > 0 AND intact-sham_no_input CI > 0 AND intact-shuffled_graph CI > 0 AND dna02_silenced yaw identically 0
decision_rule.NEGATIVE: intact TI CI entirely < 0 AND intact-sham_no_input CI < 0 (graph-mediated but anti-directional)
decision_rule.NULL: anything else, including DNa02 never spiking; subthreshold dV is reported but is not a motor effect

pilot: One pilot run (seed 999, 2 blocks of 1 s, intact) measures runtime and encoder T4/T5 firing only. DN outputs of the pilot are not inspected. If projected confirmatory runtime exceeds 60 min, seeds are cut to [0..5] and this is recorded before confirmatory runs. No parameter above is changed by the pilot.
conditional_secondary: Only if the primary result is POSITIVE: intact closed loop with slip = s*angular_velocity - yaw, same schedule, seeds 0-4, report mean |slip| reduction. Otherwise not run.
compute_cost: simulated seconds per wall second of the whole intact loop (encoder + graph + decoder + logging), all seeds, plus peak RSS
